identity: ONE original huge quadruped living-root ram, the Corkheart Rampart veteran, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter side view. Keep the body of overlapping tan cork bark plates bound by twisting brown roots, the mossy back crowned with green leaves and small white daisies, the thick ivory curled ram horns with a short forward horn on the snout, the small glowing amber heart in the chest, and the four thick root legs ending in splayed root toes. Exactly four legs and two curled horns. Preserve the cork plates, the horns, the daisies, the amber heart and the heavy proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full horns, the back foliage and all four feet within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, falling leaves, petals, dust, magic, motion trails, particles or extra limbs; the amber heart keeps only its steady glow. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-hoof support; the horns stay rigid and attached.

idle_h3_v1.action: A heavy, patient idle that loops. The bark chest swells and settles as it breathes, the horned head lowers a little and lifts again, one forefoot shifts its weight, the daisies on its back stir, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. The other feet stay planted. No walking and no attack. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

move_h3_v1.action: Walk in place through two complete reciprocal cycles with heavy, lumbering steps. Diagonal pairs of root legs alternate through reach, plant, push and lift; the knees articulate and each foot alternates taking weight and swinging. The body stays centred for engine-driven travel, the horned head nodding with each step. Finish in the original gait phase.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE horn ram toward screen right. The ram shifts its weight onto the hind legs, flexes the forelegs and draws its neck back, sinks into a deep crouch with the horns aimed forward, then shoves explosively forward with the hind legs pushing and drives the lowered horns to full reach at screen right, lands its forefeet, draws the head back and returns to the original stance. One ram only.

hit_h3_v1.action: Start rocked back in a flinch, then recover completely. The head jerks up and back, the shoulders rear and the forelegs lift slightly as the body rocks onto the hind legs, then the forefeet replant, the head comes down and the ram returns to the same stance. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Lower the horned head and spread the forelegs, then sink into a deep brace with the curled horns held forward toward screen right like a shield and the weight pressed back into the hindquarters, and hold the guard on all four planted feet. No attack and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A rallying bellow. The ram rears its forequarters up a little and lifts its horned head high with the mouth open in a bellow, the chest expanded, holds it briefly, then lowers the forefeet and head back to the original stance. A physical gesture only: no spell, glow change or aura.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse slowly and heavily. The forelegs buckle and the ram sinks onto its knees with the horned head lowering, stays there a moment, then the hind legs fold and it settles flat on its belly, the legs folded under the body and the head resting on the ground at screen right, the amber heart dimmed. The body never leaves the ground; no recovery and no disappearing body.
